summary: TradeOS v1.0 Alpha - Final verification of bug fixes from iteration_19. All 3 Quick Add regressions and Documents page 404 fix verified via Playwright. Zero console errors, zero API 404s across Command Center, Opportunities, Projects, Documents, Production Library, Settings.

verification_results.quick_add_new_opportunity: PASS - Navigates to /app/opportunities and auto-opens create-opportunity-modal via ?new=1
verification_results.quick_add_new_project: PASS - Navigates to /app/projects and auto-opens new-project-modal via ?new=1
verification_results.quick_add_quick_note_disabled: PASS - button.is_disabled() returned true, shows 'Coming soon' text
verification_results.documents_coming_soon_banner: PASS - Amber 'Document Management Coming Soon' banner rendered
verification_results.documents_no_404s: PASS - Zero /api/* 404 requests observed on Documents page (previously called /api/documents?folder=)
verification_results.api_404s_all_pages: PASS - 0 /api/* 404 responses across all tested pages

critical_code_review_comments: OpportunitiesPage.jsx and ProjectsPage.jsx both correctly consume ?new=1 via useSearchParams and clear the param via setSearchParams({}). Clean implementation.

CommandCenterPage.jsx QuickAddPanel now uses onAction callback pattern instead of dead href routes. Quick Note is properly disabled with visual affordance (opacity-60, cursor-not-allowed, amber 'Coming soon' text, no ChevronRight).

DocumentsPage.jsx no longer calls any API - useEffect just sets placeholder folders/documents. Coming Soon banner is prominent. Upload button is disabled with cursor-not-allowed. Note: the demo folders/documents are hardcoded placeholder data - acceptable for a Coming Soon preview but flag if this ships to real users unaware it's fake.

Iteration_19 open items still outstanding but not in scope of this verification: (a) transient 500 on /api/organizations/me first-paint race, (b) ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx 2157 lines needs splitting, (c) Assemblies handleCreateAssembly toast.info still uses 'coming soon' toast, (d) legacy ProductionLibraryPage.jsx has 4 'coming soon' toasts.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not submit the create modals (verification only opened them).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four fixes from iteration_19 review request verified working. Quick Add now uses onAction dispatcher in CommandCenterPage that navigates to /app/opportunities?new=1 or /app/projects?new=1. Both target pages read the query param via useSearchParams and auto-open their existing create modals. DocumentsPage no longer hits the backend at all - it renders a Coming Soon banner + demo placeholder folders. Zero console errors and zero API 404s across all main app pages. v1.0 Alpha bug-fix batch is verified. Outstanding items from iteration_19 (500 race condition on /api/organizations/me, ProductionLibraryWorkspace file size, Assemblies coming-soon toast) were NOT reintroduced but also NOT addressed in this batch - carry forward.
